message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on 18 June 1815, resulted in roughly **25,000 total casualties**—killed, wounded, or missing—across all sides.  

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allied (Napoleon’s forces) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian (Allied forces) | ~22,000 |

These figures are estimates based on contemporary reports and later historical analyses; exact numbers vary slightly among sources. The high casualty toll was a key factor in the decisive defeat of Napoleon’s army.
